creative_concept: Create an immersive botanical garden background for a garden celebration event, The scene should feature lush natural foliage in a natural landscape composition, with a warm, elegant, and peaceful atmosphere, Use a green and cream palette, with green dominating the main surfaces, The composition should emphasize the lushness and density of the foliage, with a panoramic view from a low angle, placing the focal point on a vibrant section of foliage, A green, cream palette, requested colours dominate with natural tonal variation, Requested colours control the main surfaces and visual mass, Small bounded achromatic shadows, highlights and fine structural linework may support the design, Third chromatic design colour presence remains negligible, Visual subject: Use only the supplied visual motifs and treatment, Clarified visual language: motifs: lush natural foliage, motif structure: The motif of lush natural foliage should be consistent throughout the scene, creating a cohesive and immersive botanical garden atmosphere, atmosphere: warm, peaceful, composition: natural landscape, Original brief-specific composition, coherent visual hierarchy, intentional calm negative space, balanced depth and gentle tonal modelling, Theme references are represented through brief-grounded abstract geometry, patterns, spatial structure, atmosphere and colour relationships, Architecture, environment, materials, textures and lighting are used only when supported by the brief
composition_strategy: Create a composition where lush natural foliage dominates, presenting a panoramic view of a botanical garden from a low angle, emphasizing the height and density of the foliage. Use the central band of the image to highlight the most vibrant and varied foliage, while the edges of the frame are used for quieter, more subtle elements that still contribute to the cohesive botanical garden atmosphere.

safe_region_strategy.title: Create a safe-space for the title by positioning a slightly lighter area of foliage along the top third of the image, ensuring that the text will be clearly visible against the green background.
safe_region_strategy.programme: Designate a safe-space for the programme information by incorporating a subtle, uniform area near the bottom of the image, ensuring it contrasts well with the green foliage while maintaining the botanical garden aesthetic.
